title: Chief AWS DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for a Chief AWS DevOps Engineer to build and evolve shared AWS cloud platform services that product and application teams consume, treating the platform as a product with reusable building blocks and a consistent developer experience aligned with CCoE standards. You will shape paved roads, reliability, and secure-by-design guardrails. Responsibilities Design shared cloud platform services that application teams consume as reusable building blocks Build standard compute patterns and golden baselines to accelerate safe workload onboarding Evolve paved roads and golden paths with product teams, security, and operations Maintain centralized logging, monitoring, and alerting capabilities across the platform Implement secrets management, identity, and key management integrations a
